question: Estimate the number of Indians who go shopping on Black Friday / Big Billion Days kickoff day.
idealClarificationQuestions: Online shoppers placing at least 1 order on the kickoff day? Yes.
Across all platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Nykaa)? Yes.
Includes app browsers without buying? Buyers only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Festive sale daily order volume / orders per buyer.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Big Billion Days / GIF kickoff day total orders pan-India: ~1.5-2 crore orders (across all platforms combined).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average orders per buyer on kickoff day: ~1.4 (one main + one impulse).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus app sessions without purchase (high traffic): ~6-8 crore unique app browsers.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1.2-1.5 crore unique shoppers + ~7 crore browsers on kickoff day.
